title: The Watchman
lead: The sentinel on a city wall who must warn of an approaching enemy, and a picture the prophets use of themselves and of Israel's leaders. Ezekiel is made a watchman for the house of Israel (Ezekiel 3:16-21; 33:1-9); other prophets use the image (Isaiah 21:6-12; 52:8; 56:10; Jeremiah 6:17; Habakkuk 2:1; Hosea 9:8), and Paul says he is free of the blood of all (Acts 20:26-27).
